verdict.rationale: Convertio's own web UI has you "drop your files" (plural) and convert them in one action, and the API plan advertises unlimited concurrent conversions, which suggests multi-file runs are possible. Nothing documents folder-level batch conversion, a list-driven batch mode in the CLI, or per-file status and results reporting. Missing for 10: explicit batch or folder conversion docs, CLI batch usage details, per-file result reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
